description: Property transaction history for any US address: last sale date and price, prior transactions over up to ten years, price-per-square-foot trajectory, ownership chain, recorded deed types, mortgage history, and current owner of record. For real estate research, valuation, and due diligence. Cost: $0.25 USDC via x402.

language.description: Optional. Two-letter code for results in that language (default English): fr, de, it, es, ja, pt, zh, ar, nl, el, tr, ko, sv, vi, th, id. Same price in every language.

name: interzoid_property_history
